Multilingual Website Setup コレクション

このカテゴリでできること

Translated pages need clear signals for search engines: hreflang tags that connect equivalent pages, canonical URLs that point to the right version, and robots directives that keep indexing unambiguous. This collection covers the tags that make multilingual sites easier to crawl and surface correctly.

向いている作業

  • Setting up hreflang tags for a site with two or more languages.
  • Keeping canonical URLs correct across language versions.
  • Preparing social previews and crawler rules for localized pages.

FAQ

multilingual website setupのFAQ

Should every language page include the same hreflang set?

Yes. Each equivalent page should link to every alternate version, including itself. This reciprocal pattern helps search engines understand the full language group and select the right version for each visitor.

Do I need hreflang tags for a site with only two languages?

Yes. Even two-language sites benefit from hreflang tags because they remove ambiguity about which version of a page should appear in search results for each language audience.
